resources.string: Android 16+. Request a glucose value in the system status chip.
Android 17+. Display glucose using the system metric template.

Independent of the floating overlay. These modes replace the notification chart with a system template. Enable both for MetricStyle with Live Update. The system controls promotion; without fresh data the normal notification returns.
Use system metric in the chip
MetricStyle may display its native glucose metric instead of formatted chip text. Turn this off to request the text options below.
Value and arrow order in text

Android controls chip position, font size and background opacity. Long text may be shortened or hidden. A transparent icon may still occupy space. Text options apply when Live Update is enabled; MetricStyle and device software may present them differently.
